## Description

Create `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_feature_flag.py` with RED unit tests for:
- `review.verifier_enabled` flag (default false)
- `review.verifier_failure_threshold` range validation
- Cascading-failure brake activation condition
- Telemetry field emission in verifier output

Tests fail before T2 implements the feature flag in `verifier.py` and `runner.py`.

## Done Definitions

- File exists at `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_feature_flag.py` with:
  - `test_verifier_disabled_by_default_skips_dispatch` — flag absent → verifier not called; findings returned unchanged
  - `test_verifier_enabled_true_calls_dispatch` — flag=true → verifier called with critical/important/fragile findings
  - `test_threshold_below_range_rejected` — `review.verifier_failure_threshold=0.0` → ValueError
  - `test_threshold_above_range_rejected` — `review.verifier_failure_threshold=1.1` → ValueError
  - `test_cascade_brake_activates_at_threshold_with_5_findings` — failure_rate > 0.30 AND 5+ in-scope findings → loop pause signal emitted
  - `test_cascade_brake_skipped_below_5_findings` — failure_rate > 0.30 but only 3 findings → no brake
  - `test_telemetry_fields_present_in_output` — verifier output contains `verifier_confirm_count`, `verifier_downgrade_count`, `verifier_drop_count`, `verifier_failure_rate`, `verifier_minor_finding_rate`, `verifier_fingerprints`
- `.test-index` updated: `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/verifier.py:tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_feature_flag.py`
- All tests fail (RED)

## File Impact

- `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_feature_flag.py` — NEW
- `.test-index` — UPDATED

## Testing Mode

RED
